title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-008
doc_notes: This document is a transcript of a 1987 interview conducted by the FAA/USAF with JAL Captain Kenju Terauchi regarding a UAP sighting in Alaska in 1986, as well as two previous sightings.

incidents.summary: JAL Captain Kenju Terauchi observed a large 'mothership' while taking off from Taiwan.
incidents.quote: When we start climb we saw left-hand side big mothership

incidents.summary: JAL Captain Kenju Terauchi observed bright lights in the sky during the daytime at his home.
incidents.quote: we saw bright lights, I guess maybe ah 10,000 feet

incidents.summary: JAL flight crew observed two unidentified objects with amber and white lights that paced their aircraft for several minutes before departing to a larger mothership.
incidents.quote: This light was amber and whitish, but, when it came to here it was only amber
